newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil completes N.Sea appraisal well.
newsitem.headline: Statoil completes N.Sea appraisal well.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil ) has completed drilling of appraisal well 15/5-6, spudded near to the oil find from well 15/5-5 north of the Sleipner West field in the North Sea, the Norwegian Petroleum Directorate (NPD) said on Thursday.
The well, which was drilled to a depth 2,700 metres below sea level, showed oil but was not production tested, the NPD said. It was permanently plugged and abandoned.
The NPD said the drilling provided new and important information about the 15/5-5 discovery. The results were under evaluation, it said.

Statoil, as operator of production licence 048, holds a 60.5 percent interest and is partnered by Elf Petroleum with 26.3 percent, Norsk Hydro with 9.3 percent and BP Petroleum Development of Norway with 3.9 percent.
